description: Embeds a self-hosted code-server or VS Code Server in a thread's right panel, opened at that thread's workspace so the editor shows the same files the agent is working on. One panel per thread, a compact header with the server URL and an Open in Browser link, and — for a loopback server — import of your desktop VS Code profile, keybindings, and extensions into it. You bring the server; the plugin embeds it and never proxies or weakens its authentication.
